newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Republic Glass says sells "excess" property.
newsitem.headline: Republic Glass says sells "excess" property.

text.p: Republic Glass Holdings Corp said on Tuesday it had agreed to sell some of its property to Phinma Property Holdings Inc for a total consideration of some 289 million pesos.
The properties to be sold are in excess of corporate requirements, the company said in a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange.
It said it expected a potential gain of 250 million pesos from the transaction.

Republic Glass is a holding company with its main interest in glass manufacturing. It owns 51 percent of Republic-Asahi Glass Corp, the Philippines' only flat glass manufacturer supplying car makers and the construction sector.
